candidate_sources.reason: Complete name-tag drawing candidate passes 5864 finite native scenarios with the actual VC6 sprintf wrapper, explicit callback/fault/font oracles and 94 strict game checks. Unchanged VC6 body emits 974 bytes with 966 resolved matching positions against 974 retail bytes. Canonical flag exposure preserves 207 sections/863 relocations; aggregate extraction preserves 37 sections/162 relocations. GDI is scripted; integrated HUD rendering remains unverified.

Complete multistate image and text drawing candidate checked in 16181 finite native scenarios with sixteen actual strict source helpers and the complete native VC6 conversion routine. VC6 emits 682 bytes against 672 retail bytes, with 139 resolved matching positions; extraction preserves all 733 aggregate sections and 3912 relocations. Lower GetDc, COM and GDI boundaries remain scripted; integrated menus are unverified.

Complete HUD rectangle restoration checked in 12970 finite native scenarios with actual strict texture-lock and pixel-format helpers. Explicit ordered reads preserve decoded fault behavior. VC6 emits 365 bytes against 365 retail bytes, with 77 resolved matching positions.

Complete edit-box text, image, caret and IME drawing candidate passes 14793 native scenarios with thirteen actual strict helpers and independent layout, callback, fault and held-DC checks. VC6 emits 975 bytes against 973 retail bytes, with 206 resolved matching positions; extraction preserves all 733 aggregate sections and 3912 relocations. Background GetDc and COM/GDI/IME boundaries remain scripted; integrated menu rendering is unverified.

Complete 157-byte reader against 125 retail bytes, with 8 resolved matching positions. Preserves canonical constructor and shared storage; 205632 native reader cases and 2051 source-only LZW streams pass using the actual decoder and allocation helpers. Finite valid-count and padded-stream limits are explicit.

Complete 1044-byte edit-box character handler with 1018 resolved matching positions; preserves its entire original aggregate and passes 20962 native text, callback, audio-boundary and fault scenarios with actual strict UI/sound helpers. Win32, COM and CRT boundary contracts are explicit; integrated menus remain unverified.

Complete 630-byte scene scale operation with 618 resolved matching positions; actual rendering callers and cache helpers verified in 99827 native scenarios. Floating-point operand ordering remains nonexact.

Complete steering-axis setup passes 100852 finite native cache, transform, alias, FP and fault scenarios with actual scene helpers and independent result/partial-write oracles. VC6 emits 230 bytes against 234 retail bytes, with 145 matching positions; extraction preserves all 32 aggregate sections and 90 relocations. The existing direction helper remains nonexact; arbitrary NaN payloads and resumable exception equivalence are outside this validation.

Complete engine-stream refill passes 4782 finite native state, sample-copy, callback, alias and fault cases with actual strict Sound helpers and independent byte/random-selection oracles. VC6 emits 2038 bytes against 2032 retail bytes, with 806 matching positions; extraction preserves all 106 aggregate sections and 579 relocations. COM and rand boundaries are scripted; unwritten cursor outputs and integrated audio playback are outside this validation.

Complete sub-word shifts checked in 422838 finite native cases with actual strict wrappers and mask storage, independent bit oracles, aliases and progressive faults. VC6 emits 420/438 bytes against 420/442 retail bytes, with 343/93 resolved matching positions; extraction preserves the full existing aggregate.

Complete motion-start implementation passes 320999 state, actual pose-helper, callback, rounding and exception scenarios. The 93-byte method and 368-byte ordinary C++ conversion helper preserve signed32 current-rounding results and invalid unmasked no-store behavior. Only this source uses /QIfist to avoid __ftol changing the rounding mode on a trap. The actual 59-byte pose walker remains strict. Slot4 is scripted; transient x87 stack context and integrated animation are not claimed equivalent.

Complete physics slot 6 corrects a demonstrated discarded-square-root bug and passes 78305 whole-state, actual FastSqrt, alias, floating-point-mode and progressive access-fault cases. The corrected body emits 440 bytes with 126 matching positions against 432 retail bytes, replacing a nonexact 432/287 candidate; all other aggregate sections remain unchanged. FP exceptions are masked in this finite comparison; integrated physics remains unverified.

Complete background drawing-context selection passes 21611 native region, cache, actual-helper, COM, alias and fault comparisons. The unchanged 678-byte body has 115 matching positions against 678 retail bytes; all three source helpers and the full dialog caller remain strict. Scratch globals have independently checked writable zero storage. COM DC acquisition/release are scripted; real DirectDraw/GDI and integrated menus remain untested.

Complete list-box mouse selection passes 8707 native row, real-height-helper, Windows hit-test, callback and fault scenarios. The 342-byte candidate has 306 matching positions against 342 retail bytes; an evidenced Y-before-X point-read correction changes the former 322-position partial. Selection, base dispatch and click reporting are scripted boundaries; integrated menu navigation remains untested.

Complete menu texture color scan passes 131899 native pixel, real-helper, callback, fault and held-lock comparisons. Unchanged VC6 candidate emits 220 bytes with 120 matching positions against the complete 220-byte retail body. Actual lock/unlock helpers and both callers remain strict; finite scripted COM surfaces do not establish DirectDraw behavior or menu completion.

Complete UIButton and UIMultiState pixel hit tests pass 2780 native pixel, real-helper, callback, floating-point, fault and held-lock comparisons. Unchanged VC6 candidates emit 328/303 bytes with 256/231 matching positions against complete 354/329-byte retail bodies. Four actual helpers and the CRT conversion remain strict; DirectDraw surfaces are scripted and menu navigation remains untested.

Complete per-device query passes 45489 native dispatch, real-helper, callback and finite fault comparisons. Standalone VC6 emits 124 bytes with 43 matching positions against 104 retail bytes; four actual input helpers remain strict. Prepared devices do not validate physical input or arbitrary out-of-bounds indices.

Complete default buffered joystick reader passes 4520 native record, axis, binding, button, timestamp, queue, retry, callback and fault scenarios with actual strict input helpers and the independently byte-verified VC6 conversion routine. The unchanged 1641-byte candidate has 128 matching positions against the complete 1665-byte retail extent including all switch tables. Successful COM calls fully initialize bounded records; diagnostic filenames intentionally differ. Physical devices, real acquisition, scheduling and integrated input remain untested.

Complete immediate joystick reader passes 5014 native axis, binding, button, queue, POV, floating-point, callback and fault scenarios with the real strict input helpers. The unchanged 453-byte candidate has 373 matching positions against the corrected complete 454-byte retail extent. COM success writes the full 80-byte state; binding lists and queues are bounded. Physical controllers, scheduling and the separate default buffered-input path remain untested.

Complete rectangle-copy implementation reviewed against retail COM calls, clipping, indexed pixels, aliases, callbacks and failure/fault state. Explicit ordered WORD reads preserve the observed destination-before-source fault order. All non-8-bit processed pixels retain retail's low-address byte lookup; successful non-8-bit processing is not validated. The 775-byte body has 364 matching positions against 750 retail bytes; real DirectDraw and game rendering remain untested.

Complete host racer selection passes 4270 native selection, iterator, packet, callback, floating-point and fault scenarios with the real strict iterator and VC6 conversion. An evidenced cached-view correction changes the old 346-byte/69-position partial to 342 bytes/67 positions against 340 retail bytes. Only five packet bytes are initialized by retail; the test preserves that boundary. Random values, network send and replay queue are scripted; live networking, replay files and racing remain untested.

Complete CopyMipLevels passes 5674 native state, rectangle, attachment, callback, floating-point and failure scenarios with the real strict coordinate helper and VC6 CRT conversion. The unchanged 569-byte candidate has 337 matching positions against 558 retail bytes. COM and Upload boundaries are scripted, with at most twelve successful attachments; actual pixel copying, DirectDraw ownership and integrated rendering remain untested.

Complete texture cloning and both allocation cleanup states pass 135464 native state, argument, color-key, callback, failure and unwind scenarios. VC6 emits 590 bytes against the full 600-byte retail body with 333 matching positions. The actual strict pixel-size helper executes; allocation, constructors, registration, surfaces, creation and deletion are scripted. Existing constructor/destructor/deleting-wrapper providers are separately strict; integrated texture lifecycle and rendering remain untested.

Complete PCTextureMap surface setup passes 12226 native descriptor, mip-count, reference, conversion-boundary, callback and fault scenarios, using three strict source-format helpers. VC6 emits 2028 bytes against the corrected complete 2033-byte retail body with 518 matching positions. COM surfaces, conversion and larger helpers are scripted; minimum mip size is positive, and actual pixel conversion, drivers and integrated rendering remain untested.

Complete menu screen capture passes 8237 native pixel, state, callback, allocation, fault and unwind scenarios. VC6 emits 888 bytes against the complete 896-byte retail body with 284 matching positions. Rendering, surfaces, format lookup, allocation and texture creation are scripted; real DirectDraw capture and modal menus remain untested.

Complete MediaControl Open passes 11125 native scripted COM, OS and helper scenarios including output aliasing, callback mutations, failures and faults. VC6 emits 656 bytes against the complete 646-byte retail body with 53 matching positions. Actual SDK and canonical GUID providers are checked; live DirectShow decoding, DirectDraw drivers and downstream Release cleanup remain untested.

Complete race-to-menu transition passes 9437 native state, display/input, callback, allocation, fault and unwind scenarios. VC6 emits 533 bytes against the complete 531-byte retail body with 454 matching positions; generated TransDlg destructor helpers are strict. GUI, display, IME, result-recording, audio and allocation boundaries are scripted; live menu rendering and device transitions remain untested.

Complete replay worker passes 24595 native event, payload, whole-state, lock, failure, mutation and termination scenarios. Both complete extents are 2148 bytes, with 2100 matching positions. Twenty existing ring/file helpers, synchronization APIs and thread exit are scripted; actual scheduling, file I/O and integrated recording/playback remain untested.

Complete KrustyUI startup passes 13540 native whole-state, allocation, exception, fault, profile and callback scenarios; generated Intro1Dlg destructor helpers match strictly. VC6 emits 1102 bytes against 1104 retail bytes with 872 matching positions. GUI, resource, profile and device dependencies are scripted; rendered menus and live navigation remain untested.

Complete VCRInterface replay tick passes 147749 native whole-state, callback, lock, exception, fault and floating-point scenarios with the real VC6 conversion helper. VC6 emits 2448 bytes against 2412 retail bytes, retaining 276 matching positions. Complete FollowCamera control handler passes 195339 native input, whole-state, callback, exception, fault and floating-point scenarios. VC6 emits 4046 bytes against the complete 4058-byte retail body, retaining 927 matching positions. Input callbacks are scripted; real DirectInput and rendered camera behavior remain untested.

Complete streamed-audio loader passes 37387 native queue, ownership, lock, callback, exception and fault comparisons. VC6 emits 478 bytes versus 483 retail bytes; the five game helpers and synchronization boundaries are scripted, so real scheduling and audio playback remain untested.

Complete tooltip placement and pointer ownership helpers pass 19606 native state, coordinate, callback, exception and fault comparisons. VC6 emits the full 106/52-byte extents with 89/46 matching positions; ShowText and real input devices remain outside this scripted boundary test.

Complete 492-byte matrix update passes 76288 native scripted state/argument/exception cases and 9216 cases with initialized source math providers. VC6 retains 487 matching positions; real rendering remains untested.

Complete non-local texture-memory probe passes 12912 native full-state, call, alias, fault and ownership comparisons. Full retail CFG is 486 bytes including the final ret8; VC6 emits 490 bytes. Dependencies are scripted and invalid-path behavior is retained.

Complete partial-upload startup probe passes 26600 native state, ownership, ordered-call, C++ exception and access-violation scenarios. Full retail CFG is 1129 bytes; standalone VC6 candidate is 1145 bytes. Image, texture and display dependencies are scripted.

Complete display-mode surface setup passes 200448 native arithmetic, budget-boundary, whole-state and callback comparisons. VC6 emits 124 bytes versus 116 retail; invalid mode storage is outside this finite validation.

Complete SetMatrixIn and SetAxesIn reviewed against retail and checked with the direction transform in 86016 native full-state/alias scenarios. VC6 emits 1134/1171 bytes against 1096/1171 retail; the 41-byte transpose helper remains strict exact. Cache dependencies are scripted in the differential test.

Complete crash filter checked in 13838 native differential scenarios, including both SEH regions and one-shot state. VC6 emits 1277 bytes versus 1290 retail bytes; the stack-base load uses the paired OS backend.

Ordinary-C++ stack-base backend dynamically calls the current OS NtCurrentTeb export. 1536 native main/worker/fiber checks match independent OS bounds; both unavailable-backend paths raise into the reporter's guarded stack-dump failure path.

Complete Tick and profiler calibration checked in 39376 native differential scenarios; QPC replaces the four retail RDTSC boundaries consistently. Gameplay retains ReadClock. VC6 emits 716/204 bytes versus 683/196 retail bytes.
Explicit QPC profiling backend for both Tick stamps and calibration, independently checked in 4096 native bracketed calls. This is a functional platform adaptation, not a retail-byte reconstruction.
Complete DirectX startup probe; VC6 emits 1006 bytes versus 1011 retail bytes due to register allocation and spill differences.
Five complete buffered/archive stream methods reviewed against retail and checked in 12390 native differential scenarios; VC6 bytes remain nonexact.
Complete AddArchive loader checked in 17292 native differential scenarios including constructor unwind paths; VC6 emits 798 bytes versus 804 retail bytes.
